notes: This run was explicitly scoped BUILD + REVIEW ONLY by the operator. No credentials existed, so no `appmixer test`, `appmixer publish`, `appmixer e2e import/run`, `appmixer account create`, and no authenticated HTTP call to the Hugging Face API was made. Nothing in this connector has been executed against the live API.

API surface was researched from current public docs only. Key finding: the router's OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface covers chat completions ONLY - there is NO /v1/embeddings. Embeddings, classification, summarization and text-to-image therefore go through the hf-inference task routes on router.huggingface.co. The legacy api-inference.huggingface.co host is deliberately unused.

Two response shapes must be unwrapped and are the most likely source of a first-run CLI test failure: text-classification returns [[{label, score}]] (double-nested) and summarization returns [{summary_text}] (single-nested). Both are handled, but neither has been verified against a live response.

Text-to-image response Content-Type is not documented; GenerateImage accepts any image/* content type and also handles the {data:[{b64_json}]} and {output:[url]} JSON variants used by non-hf-inference providers.

The `direction` query param on Hub GET /api/models could not be verified against current docs or the current Python client - it is historically supported and harmless if ignored (results would just come back ascending).

FindModels builds its own query string rather than passing `params` to axios, because the Hub expects `filter` as a REPEATED key and the default axios serializer emits the `filter[]=` bracket form. This was a review finding, fixed before commit.
E2E validator warning `create-without-cleanup` on CreateEmbeddings is a false positive - an embedding is a computed value, not a persisted resource, so there is nothing to delete.
E2E validator `component-coverage` warnings in the run output refer to OTHER connectors in the workspace (requesty, voyageai). All 8 huggingface components ARE covered by the two generated flows.

Assertion values chosen to be deterministic: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 has exactly 384 dimensions; sst-2 returns POSITIVE for the sample sentence; SendPrompt uses temperature 0. If the E2E run later fails on the SendPrompt regex, the likely cause is the model appending punctuation, not a connector defect.
appmixer test component binds a FIXED port 2300 — two component tests cannot run concurrently; the second dies with EADDRINUSE. Run them sequentially.
SendPrompt: the router silently remaps meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo in the response, so never assert equality on the returned model id.

SendPrompt at temperature 0 is still not word-exact: asked to reply "PONG" it answered "Classic". The E2E asserts use factual substrings (Lisbon, Eiffel) rather than exact echoes, which is the right call.
facebook/bart-large-cnn needs a cold start of roughly two minutes on first call; the CLI default 120 s timeout is not enough.
The upstream remote clientIO/appmixer-connectors redirects to Appmixer-ai/appmixer-connectors — the org was renamed, so PRs land on Appmixer-ai.

fixesApplied: GenerateImage routed text-to-image through the legacy hf-inference provider, which no longer serves it: every popular checkpoint answers HTTP 410 "The requested model is deprecated and no longer supported by provider hf-inference", and others 400 "Model not supported". The router exposes no OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations endpoint (404). Fixed by routing through a named Inference Provider: new `provider` input (default fal-ai), URL is {ROUTER_BASE_URL}/{provider}/{model} with the model path NOT repo-encoded so its slashes survive.

GenerateImage requests responseType arraybuffer, so error bodies surfaced as raw byte arrays (an unreadable list of numbers). Added describeHttpError() to decode the buffer to text; a dead model now reports "Provider hf-inference cannot serve model X: Model not supported by provider hf-inference".
Added the fal.ai {images:[{url}]} response shape (findImageUrl/findImageBase64 now cover images[].url, images[] as string, output[], data[].url, data[].b64_json and image_url).
Provider-aware request body: hf-inference keeps the {inputs, parameters} transformers shape; every other provider takes the prompt at top level.

E2E flow test-flow-inference-tasks.json: GenerateImage was bound to black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell with no provider, which would 404 under the new routing. Rebound to fal-ai/flux/schnell + provider fal-ai in config.transform lambda, with a matching modifiers entry.
